description: Fire the orphaned implement-blocked marker sweep at plan-phase dispatch (mid-session), not only at sidecar startup.

userStories.title: Sweep orphaned implement-blocked marker at plan-phase dispatch
userStories.description: As the sidecar orchestrator, I need the orphaned implement-blocked marker sweep to run at the start of every plan-phase dispatch (not just at process startup) so that a marker that becomes orphaned mid-session (operator ships/abandons its issue without a fresh sidecar boot) is cleared before the next plan preflight reads it, instead of lingering until the next process start.
acceptanceCriteria: sweepOrphanedImplementBlockedMarker is invoked at the start of the plan-phase dispatch closure returned by makeProductionPlanPhaseFn (sidecar.ts ~2354), before runProductionPlanPhaseWithReplan / runPlanPreflight run. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

The mid-session sweep reuses the existing injectable seam sweepOrphanedImplementBlockedMarkerFn (threaded from SidecarOptions through buildPlanPhaseDeps into makeProductionPlanPhaseFn), defaulting to the same production sweepOrphanedImplementBlockedMarker(join(claudeDir, IMPLEMENT_BLOCKED_FILENAME), cwd) call as the startup site. [oracle: grep -q 'sweepOrphanedImplementBlockedMarkerFn' src/commands/sidecar.ts]
The mid-session sweep uses the read-only-on-main path and never touches the working tree (no checkout/pull/stage introduced). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
A new wiring test asserts the sweep fn fires when the plan-phase dispatch closure runs (the startup and preflight call sites currently have no wiring test). [oracle: bun test test/commands/]

The existing runSidecar startup call site (sidecar.ts ~2881) and the pure-function tests in test/commands/sidecar-orphan-sweep.test.ts remain unchanged and green. [oracle: bun test test/commands/sidecar-orphan-sweep.test.ts]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Single-file source change: src/commands/sidecar.ts. (1) Add a sweep-fn parameter to makeProductionPlanPhaseFn (sidecar.ts:2345-2354) and invoke it as the very first statement inside the returned closure (line ~2354), inside the existing try so any error is swallowed by the outer safety net. (2) Thread the seam from options in buildPlanPhaseDeps (sidecar.ts:2491-2493): pass options.sweepOrphanedImplementBlockedMarkerFn ?? (() => sweepOrphanedImplementBlockedMarker(join(claudeDir, IMPLEMENT_BLOCKED_FILENAME), cwd)). cwd and claudeDir are already in scope there. Gotchas (from issue spec): do NOT modify the pure sweep function (sidecar.ts:609) nor its tests (test/commands/sidecar-orphan-sweep.test.ts); do NOT add an idle-tick / per-tick sweep site (the circuit-breaker read at src/supervisor/loop.ts:2194/2198 is intentionally NOT a sweep site); preserve the read-only-on-main invariant (readBacklogFromMain uses git ls-tree/cat-file only). Keep makeProductionPlanPhaseFn under biome's 80-line / cognitive-complexity limits (it is already at the limit and uses extracted helpers) so check:all stays green. Wiring test: mirror the injection style in test/supervisor/plan/plan-sidecar-replan-wiring.test.ts (inject runPlanPhaseFn or drive buildPlanPhaseDeps with a spy seam) and assert the spy is called when the plan-phase closure executes. Type is fix (copied from issue). Parent context CAM-282 shipped the .gitignore fix + startup+preflight sweep; this closes the mid-session window flagged in AC6 of CAM-282.
